'''Ruuria''', on the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the insectoid [[Ruurian/Legends|Ruurians]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was located near the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. It featured tropical jungles, manufacturing centers, and universities. Ruuria was a member of the [[Unified Ruurian Colonies]].

The Ruurians' society was made up of 143 colonies,<ref name="TCSWE" /> and every Ruurian belonged to a single colony for life.

==History==
[[File:Ruurian_UAA.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A [[Ruurian/Legends|Ruurian]]]]
During the [[Jedi Civil War]], Ruuria aligned with the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TEA" /> Nearly 300 years later, in [[3681 BBY]], the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] established a puppet government on Ruuria which then helped scatter the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] forces in the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]] [[Tingel Arm campaign|campaign]].<ref name="TJoMGD" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Ruuria remained a [[Loyalist/Legends|loyalist]] world.<ref name="TEA" />

Ruuria briefly surrendered to the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] when [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] seemingly returned from the dead in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]].<ref name="VotF" />
